hero.subtitle: Specialty coffee concept builder and trainer based in Amman. I shape the parts customers never see — the menu, the machines, the people — so the room still works long after opening week.

work.title: Concepts I
work.intro: Twelve rooms across Jordan — from first sketch to the morning the doors opened. I don't own them. I make them work.

approach.title: From empty room
approach.intro: Every project runs the same disciplined path — no skipped steps, no guesswork.
approach.concept_desc: Position, identity, and the customer experience — settled before a single machine is bought.
approach.equipment_desc: The right grinders, machines, and bar layout, specced to the menu rather than the trend.
approach.menu_desc: A drink list engineered for consistency, speed, and margin.
approach.training_desc: Baristas taken from first shift to floor-ready, with standards that hold under pressure.
approach.launch_desc: Dialed in, dress-rehearsed, and ready for the first real rush.

craft.title: Competition-level latte art,
craft.intro: Eleven years of muscle memory behind the bar. The standard I hold myself to is the standard I train every team toward.

teaching.title: Where I train the next bar.
teaching.intro: Coffee outlives any single café when the skill is passed on. I build and deliver curricula for three Jordanian institutions.

courses.bau_desc: A full module on extraction theory, sensory training, and competition-level latte art for hospitality students.
courses.jrf_desc: Vocational barista training that turns first-time staff into floor-ready professionals.
courses.jaa_desc: Service and beverage standards built for high-volume, high-expectation environments.

about.title: I work behind the bar, not on the lease.
about.p1: Eleven years in specialty coffee taught me that a great café is engineered, not stumbled into. I'm the person owners bring in before the espresso machine is even chosen.
about.p2: I've shaped the concept, equipment, menu, and team for twelve cafés across Jordan, and I've trained baristas at three national institutions. Along the way I became Jordan's Latte Art Champion — a title that still keeps me honest behind the bar.
about.p3: I have no intention of opening a café. I have every intention of making yours work.

store.title: Coffee Tools & Essentials
store.intro: The same kit I spec for the bars I build — tampers, pitchers, scales, and the small tools that separate a good shot from a consistent one. Curated, nothing filler.

contact.title: Let's make the room work.
contact.subtitle: New concept, struggling bar, or a team that needs training — start here.

footer.tagline: I build coffee concepts that outlive the trend.
